Spinach Ham cheese Omelette
 


Ingredients


 Eggs Large 3
 Butter 2 tbsp 
 Cheddar or Mozzarella cheese 50g
 Chicken Ham 100g finely chopped 
 Baby Spinach few Springs 
 Salt and pepper as per teste 
 Water 2 tbsp




 


Method


1) Beat eggs and water in a bowl until blended.


2) Heat the butter in a nonstick pan over medium high heat until hot. Tilt pan to coat bottom. Pour in egg mixture. Mixture should set immediately at edges.


3) Gently push cooked portions from edges toward the centrer with inverted Turner so that uncooked eggs can reach the hot pan surface continue cooking, tilting pan and gently moving cooked portions as needed.


4) When top surface of eggs is thickened and no visible liquid Egg remains, season with salt and pepper. Place the cheese on one side of Omelette. Top with Spinach & chicken ham fold Omelette in half with turner. With a quick flip of the wrist, turn a pan and invert or slide Omelette onto plate. Serve immediately.

Ingredients


 Eggs Large 3
 Butter 2 tbsp 
 Cheddar or Mozzarella cheese 50g
 Chicken Ham 100g finely chopped 
 Baby Spinach few Springs 
 Salt and pepper as per teste 
 Water 2 tbsp




 


Method

4) When top surface of eggs is thickened and no visible liquid Egg remains, season with salt and pepper. Place the cheese on one side of Omelette. Tuna Cutlets
 


Ingredient

 Tuna fish 300g Boiled
 Olive oil 1 tbsp
 Mayonnaise 1/2 tbsp
 Salt as per teste requirements 
 Garlic Gloves 3 to 4 minced
 large Eggs 1 lightly beaten 
 Green chilli 3- 4 finely chopped
 Black Pepper Powder 1/4 tbsp
 Parsley 1/2 Sprigs finely chopped
 Musted cream 1/2 tbsp



 


Method


1) Preheat the oven to the "Keep warm" setting ( 150 - 170 degrees F )


2) In a medium bowl, Use a fork to mix together the tuna, Mayonnaise, mustard cream, minced Garlic, Eggs, Green chilli chopped, Salt, Black pepper powder, and parsley. 


3) Heat the Olive oil in a large non stick skillet over medium heat.


4) Measuring 1/4 Cup of the mixture for each cake. Fry the patties until the golden brown, about three minutes per each side.


5) Keep the cooked tuna cakes in a warm oven while frying other cakes.


6) Serve it immediately.

Hot Butter Mushroom 


Ingredient 


 Mushroom 150g
 Chili powder Pepper 1 tbsp
 Chilli pieces 1/2 tbsp
 Curry Powder 1/2 teaspoon
 Salt powder As per teste
 Ginger & Garlic paste 1 tbsp
 Coconut oil 1 tbsp
 Coconut Milk 1 Cup
 Butter 1 tbsp
 Tomato 1 
 Pepper Powder 1 tbsp


 


Method 



 Tear the Mushrooms into small pieces. Then add chili powder, pepper powder, salt and mix well. 


 Place a pot on the stove and fry the Mushrooms in deep oil until golden. 


 Then place a separate vessel on the stove and add a little more butter and heat it. 


 After the butter melts, add crushed ginger & garlic paste and curry powder. After it binds, add pieces of chillies, add half a cup less milk and tomato sauce to it. 


 After that, add salt to the required seasoning and after it boils well, add the fried Mushrooms, stir and cook.


 Hot Butter Mushroom is Ready to teste.
